unique_formulas.formula: ="Live KPI overview across all flocks  |  Report generated: "&TEXT(TODAY(),"dd mmm yyyy")

=IF(calc_KPI_Engine!E2<>"Active","",IF(calc_KPI_Engine!J2<INDEX(mst_Settings[Value],MATCH("TargetLivabilityPct",mst_Settings[Parameter],0)),"Livability below target - investigate mortality",IF(calc_KPI_Engine!O2>INDEX(mst_Settings[Value],MATCH("TargetFCR",mst_Settings[Parameter],0)),"FCR above target - review feed efficiency","Within normal range")))

=IF(calc_KPI_Engine!E3<>"Active","",IF(calc_KPI_Engine!J3<INDEX(mst_Settings[Value],MATCH("TargetLivabilityPct",mst_Settings[Parameter],0)),"Livability below target - investigate mortality",IF(calc_KPI_Engine!O3>INDEX(mst_Settings[Value],MATCH("TargetFCR",mst_Settings[Parameter],0)),"FCR above target - review feed efficiency","Within normal range")))
